Editorial cover hero, warm paper surface, semantic panel fills, and original source-backed values remain balanced at desktop width.
Dark semantic fills remain distinct while labels, icons, values, and state pills remain legible.

Three coral, mint, and butter bento sections read as separate groups with source evidence and limits retained.
Dark mode retains the same section hierarchy with distinct coral, mint, and butter surfaces.
The narrow timeline rail and two-tone event markers remain inside the viewport; the long date wraps within its chip.
The indigo/coral event sequence is easy to scan at desktop width; excerpt and unknown-field labels remain explicit.
